what_it_does_not_supply: the house in 1812: it shows it eight years later, after the family's return in 1816
what_it_supplies: the earliest picture of the house: end-on from the east, its gable toward the eye, the ridge along the river and the front slope carried low over the piazza on the river side
two stacks through the ridge, one just behind the east gable
two windows in the east end under the gable, and light, smooth walls
a log building, a whitewashed house and a yard fence round it in 1820
the second Fort Dearborn across the river to the left
